scope: Read-only preparation for one outer FALSUM ACP verification job using one fresh Telegraph SECURITY_REVIEW_GENERAL call. No buyer, signer, job, deposit, payment, transfer or approval was executed.

sandbox.authorized_route: Virtuals ACP platform non-public developer Sandbox / Sandbox Butler mode
self_evaluation_shape: both registered with the Service Registry
platform smart wallet and developer-wallet whitelist where required

expected_acp_network.name: Base
expected_acp_network.basis: Official Butler guide accepts USDC on Base mainnet only; official legacy self-evaluation example uses BASE_MAINNET_ACP_X402_CONFIG_V2.

sandbox.blocker: No platform-designated Sandbox identity/access or separate authenticated buyer session is available locally.

provider.name: FALSUM
provider.receive_conclusion: Historical empty registry metadata alone does not block the SDK receive path; current mainnet provider support includes 8453. This is readiness evidence, not a live-job claim.

telegraph.quote_status: read-only 402 observed; no payment header redeemed
telegraph.x402_gas_condition: Use EIP-3009 exact authorization/facilitator settlement; abort if the buyer is asked for native gas or an on-chain approval.

expected_actions: buyer fund (allowance plus fund may be batched)
acp.native_gas: must be zero/sponsored; no native-gas funding is approved

binding.reason: Historical Telegraph receipts do not contain the exact Anchor request digest, response digest or ACP job ID. Existing FALSUM custody is caller-supplied and explicitly does not authenticate settlement.
required_cross_binding: exact Telegraph request bytes to request_sha256
exact Telegraph response bytes to response_sha256
x-telegraph-receipt fields to verified Base Sepolia token receipt
exact ACP requirement bytes to requirement_sha256
FALSUM response digest and receipt_hash to the same custody manifest

conditional_second_acp_report_job.required_if: Virtuals/FALSUM requires report_job to be a separate paid ACP job
conditional_second_acp_report_job.action: abort; no approval under the proposed 0.02 USDC cap
